requires: The source has fixed H_S=Omega X/2 and L_S=sqrt(gamma)Z, gamma>0, Omega!=0, duration T>0, vacuum input and coherent collection 0<eta<=1 BEFORE irreversible amplification; the remaining field is inaccessible and the final source is discarded. Capacity is qubits per fixed-T source window with local quantum operations and two-way classical communication. Alice can prepare source-memory Bell pairs, retain memory A, and later teleport the payload; there is no pre-shared EPR pair. Bob has a cold finite passive ladder, programmable scalar coupling, local flag filters, phase correction, gates and storage. Stationary independent trials and accurate local operations are premises. A fitted reduced dephasing equation alone does not acquire the coherent field interface.
provides: The displayed equations and supplied package specify H_SC=Omega*X/2+GZ(a+a^dagger), L_cav=sqrt(kappa_c)*a; Omega=1, T=pi, gamma=.005/pi, kappa_c=20, G=1/sqrt(40pi), eta=.01. Bob uses ONE qubit, R=-i*sqrt(.2)*sigma_minus and H_B=Z_B/2. J1=sqrt(eta*kappa_c)*a+R, J2=sqrt((1-eta)*kappa_c)*a. All outputs are traced, with no photon counter.

The filters use v=sqrt(4eta*gamma/.2)*(1-exp(-.2T/2)) and the recorded local phase 0.09745901407420347. Recorded lower bounds are success >5.0000221e-6 and Bell fidelity >.8942083, with unnormalized total error <4.1370e-10. Two IDEAL purification levels give error <6.94e-9 and expected windows <8.81e6.

Factorial moments M_m<=alpha^(2m), alpha=2G/kappa_c, give full diamond cutoff error <=2GT*sqrt(N)*alpha^(N-1)/sqrt((N-1)!). At N=6 this is <7.081e-12. Exact displayed math strings and the package README resolve the duplicated rendered glyphs without guessed coefficients.

The package contains seven original members: README, all-ratio/purification code, cavity certificate, directed interval arithmetic audit software, Decimal interval helper, recorded JSON result and an earlier smooth Markov ODE check used for matrix primitives. The reported certificate uses 50-digit directed Decimal intervals, a pi enclosure, degree-16 Taylor evolution over 4096 steps and explicit Taylor/binary64 roundoff and normalization budgets. None of these programs was executed by Capital.

The arithmetic software and recorded result are supplied source evidence, not an independent mathematical reviewer report, formally verified library or laboratory measurement. The earlier adaptive ODE check is not the cavity certificate and does not prove all parameter values. The one operating point does not give a uniform finite-bandwidth lower bound as eta tends to zero. Established coherent-measurement transfer, absorbers, decoders, lossless positivity, single-photon entanglement, shaped transfer and controlled sideband exchange are credited; practical advantage is not established.
assumptions: The source reports proofs and computations; Capital performed no scientific reproof, replay or independent mathematical audit. Retained memory and repeatable prepared entanglement are essential: this does not recover an already inaccessible unknown source state after a failed attempt. No lost-field measurement, time reversal, source feedback or global field unitary is supplied. The positive rate is TWO-WAY CLASSICALLY ASSISTED, not an unassisted rate or qubits per second. Finite dimension independent of eta does not make precision, waiting or throughput independent of eta. The weak-drive rate coefficient vanishes. The one-percent collection cavity point is not a uniform finite-bandwidth bound as eta tends to zero. Local gate, storage, preparation, reset and classical propagation costs include failed trials. The supplied arithmetic audit is software plus recorded results, not an independent mathematical reviewer report or a formally verified library. It assumes the stated IEEE arithmetic model and is not experimental data. Priority, a competitive hardware advantage and arbitrary thermal-port capability remain unestablished.
